result.instructions: Tools for Billy, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customer invoices are still unpaid and past their due date?"; "What did we invoice in total last month?"; "Show me all supplier bills from this quarter that are still waiting for approval.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Billy data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run billy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run billy_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run billy_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. billy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: billy_get_organization
tools.title: Get the company
tools.description: The Billy company the access token belongs to: id, name, address, registration (CVR) number, base currency, VAT settings, fiscal year, default payment terms, invoice numbering, default accounts. Good first call. GET /organization.

tools.name: billy_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List customers and suppliers: name, type, address, CVR/registration number, EAN, payment terms, customer/supplier flags. The API has no documented search filter, so `search` is applied to the returned page only (case-insensitive on name, contact number and registration number); page on with next_page to look further. Paged. GET /contacts.

search.description: Keep only contacts on the returned page whose name, contactNo or registrationNo contains this text.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: billy_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: One contact by id, with its contact persons (names and e-mail addresses). GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: billy_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices and credit notes (newest first by default): number, date, due date, state (draft/approved/voided), amount, tax, balance, isPaid, contactId, currency. Filter by state, customer, number, date, period, paid status or free text. Paged. GET /invoices.

contact_id.description: Only invoices of this contact (from billy_list_contacts).

is_paid.description: true = only paid invoices, false = only unpaid.

max_due_date.description: Due date on or before (yyyy-mm-dd); with is_paid=false this finds overdue invoices.

q.description: Free-text search over invoice number, order number, contact name, line description, amount.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: billy_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: One invoice by id with its lines (product, description, quantity, unit price, amount, tax) and its payment associations. GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: billy_list_bills
tools.title: List bills (supplier invoices)
tools.description: List bills (purchase invoices from suppliers): supplier, dates, state (draft/approved/voided), amount, balance, isPaid, supplier invoice number. Filter by state, supplier, dates or paid status. Paged. GET /bills.

contact_id.description: Only bills of this supplier contact.

is_paid.description: true = only paid bills, false = only unpaid.

q.description: Free-text search over supplier name, description, voucher number, amount, supplier invoice number.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: billy_get_bill
tools.title: Get a bill
tools.description: One supplier bill by id with its lines. GET /bills/{id}.

tools.name: billy_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products and services usable as invoice lines: name, product number, description, sales account, archived flag. The API has no documented search filter, so `search` is applied to the returned page only (name, productNo). Paged. GET /products.

search.description: Keep only products on the returned page whose name or productNo contains this text.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: billy_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: One product by id with its unit prices per currency. GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: billy_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts (chart of accounts)
tools.description: The chart of accounts: account number, name, group, nature, VAT rate, bank-account flag and bank details (IBAN, bank name) of bank accounts. With is_bank_account=true this lists the bank accounts whose ids billy_list_bank_lines needs. Paged. GET /accounts.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: billy_list_tax_rates
tools.title: List tax (VAT) rates
tools.description: The company's VAT rates: name, rate (as a fraction, 0.25 = 25 percent), whether it applies to sales or purchases, active flag. Paged. GET /taxRates.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: billy_list_bank_lines
tools.title: List bank lines
tools.description: List the bank-statement lines of ONE bank account (read only; nothing is matched or reconciled): date, description, amount, side (debit/credit), reconciled flag, receipt state. Get the account id from billy_list_accounts with is_bank_account=true. Paged. GET /bankLines.

is_reconciled.description: true = only reconciled lines, false = only unreconciled.

status.description: Line status (the API defaults to booked).

side.description: Only debit (money in) or credit (money out) lines.

receipt_state.description: Only lines with a missing or uploaded receipt.

q.description: Free-text search over description or amount.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: billy_list_postings
tools.title: List ledger postings
tools.description: List ledger postings (the bookkeeping entries): date, text, account, amount, side (debit/credit), currency, voided flag. Filter by account, date or period. Read only. Paged. GET /postings.

account_id.description: Only postings on this account (from billy_list_accounts).

is_voided.description: true = only voided postings, false = only live ones.

q.description: Free-text search over the posting text and the originator name.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: billy_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: WRITE: create ONE new contact (customer and/or supplier) in the company's Billy account. It does not check for duplicates (call billy_list_contacts first) and nothing is sent to the contact. Not idempotent: a repeat call creates a second contact. POST /contacts.

registration_no.description: CVR number (Denmark) or EU VAT number.

contact_no.description: Your own customer or supplier number.

email.description: Primary contact e-mail (stored as the primary contact person; nothing is sent).

tools.name: billy_create_draft_invoice
tools.title: Create a draft invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create ONE invoice in the DRAFT state for an existing contact. The invoice is NOT approved, booked, numbered into the ledger or sent: the user reviews it in Billy and approves and sends it there. The invoice number is assigned by Billy. No payment is created. Not idempotent: a repeat call creates a second draft. POST /invoices with state=draft.

contact_id.description: The customer's contact id (from billy_list_contacts or billy_create_contact).

currency_id.description: Invoice currency, e.g. DKK (default: the company's base currency).

tax_mode.description: Whether unit prices include (incl) or exclude (excl) VAT (default: the company's setting).

contact_message.description: Message to the customer shown at the top of the invoice PDF.

unit_price.description: Price per unit in the invoice currency (VAT excluded unless tax_mode is incl).

description.description: Text shown under the product name on the invoice.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Billy
prompts.description: What you can do with Billy here, with example requests to try.
